protocol: camera 0 (never used for fitting) foreground PSNR, reported beside physics; appearance per method's own native renderer
metric: foreground PSNR (dB) on camera 0; mask = truth-render pixels not pure white; MSE pooled over frames 1..end; full-frame PSNR also given
transfer: IDW (1/d^2, K=4 nearest source rest points); identity when the model renders its own particles; true motion also via exact FE interpolation (fe-interp)

not_rendered.reason: sealed output is 27 top-surface probe displacements only (pred-fem-*.npz); no full field or particles to drive an appearance; re-simulating after truth opened would not be a sealed prediction
native renderer: no native renderer in adapter (shared-appearance and rasteriser rows only)
